question: What bodily and perceptual powers result from mastery of the third wheel?
premises: Destruction of wrinkles and grey hair is attained.
Seeing from very far away is attained.
Both are presented as results of the practice.
inference: Mastery of the third wheel brings removal of wrinkles and grey hair and vision from afar.
plain_english: One gains the destruction of wrinkles and grey hair, and likewise the ability to see from very far away.
